title: Dhaka University Establishment
subtitle: A new institutional center in eastern Bengal politics and culture.
summary: The establishment of the University of Dhaka in 1921 created a major educational and intellectual institution that later shaped political mobilization, language activism, and public leadership in East Bengal.
heroTagline: A new institutional center in eastern Bengal politics and culture.
whyItMatters: It provided the social-intellectual infrastructure for later mass politics in East Bengal and East Pakistan.
